gaps.item: Your sittings (T6) gets the thin legacy history rows: no #number, M1/M2, time, miss/blank chips, route/cap/rank chips, paper/retake labels; filters, sorts, notes and CSV module columns fail
gaps.source: rebuild-v2.md §3.4.3 §2.8 T6 and §3.4.5 History; tests.md §3.1 item 23, X1, X18; acceptance 18, 36, 37
gaps.evidence: GET /api/history?all=1 goes to api_practice.history_without_inline (registered before api_results' route), which returns {id,kind,started,finished,right,asked,estimate,topics,label} and no finished-row status/number/modules/route/paper/note. Seeded learner at 1280: rows read 'Sep 28 · 00:42 Full section adaptive · official 630–770 Compare Review Fix 5 Twin Share Note' with no #, M1, M2, minutes or chips. The Paper #1 sitting shows as 'Full section' with no Retake. The lower-routed Sep 26 row has no 'Try the harder module 2'. ?kind=paper and ?route=lower both give 'No sittings match these filters.' PUT /session/{id}/note returned 200, but after a reload every .sr-note is hidden and empty (history carries no note). The score card's source line reads 'From Full section' for a paper sitting. api_tests.sitting_row has every field the page needs, but only /api/tests.in_progress uses it.
gaps.build: Make the served GET /api/history?all=1 return api_tests.sitting_row(row) for every finished, non-abandoned test sitting (mock, module, custom, diagnostic), newest first, with api_tests.open_sittings in the same shape. Do it by removing or merging the shadowing api_practice route and having api_results.history call deps.part('api_tests','sitting_row') for test kinds. Keep R24's inline-drill exclusion. Then check that number, modules[].missed/blank, route, paper, retake, note, conditions, ranked and unranked_why reach the page.

gaps.item: Compare sheet (X18) never shows the slot-by-slot or type diff, and wrongly says nothing was missed
gaps.source: tests.md X18 (Compare sheet, Data, Acceptance)
gaps.evidence: /tests/?compare=s1,s2 opened a sheet with only Date/Band/Wrong/Blank ('WRONG 10 13 BLANK 0 0') and 'Question types: No question type was missed in either sitting.' Both sittings had 10+ misses. GET /api/session/{a}/compare?with={b} returns {subject, with, paired, unpaired, slots:[{n,module,template,then,now,change,same_trap}]}. compare.js reads {by, a, b, rows, summary}, so it drops to the empty template branch. The head also lacks M1, M2, route and margin, time, away, pauses, conditions and the domain bars. The titles read 'Full section and Full section' with no numbers.
gaps.build: Make the compare endpoint return X18's shape {by:'slot'|'template', a:{domains,...}, b:{...}, rows:[{slot_label, topic_name, a, b, same_trap, still}|{group:'both'|'fixed'|'new', template, topic_name, trap}], summary:{fixed, still, new, held, pts}}. Use by:'slot' when one sitting is a twin, retake or rematch of the other. Or adapt compare.js to the existing slots/change shape. Then fill the head facts from the fixed history rows.

gaps.item: Race friends does nothing: Compete accepts neither from_session nor paper, and /compete/ ignores ?create=
gaps.source: tests.md X22 (Race friends) and §3.2 row §3.7 Compete
gaps.evidence: POST /api/contests {from_session, count:22, minutes:35, twin:true, open_for:72} → 409 'choose a skill with available questions'. The same with {paper:1,...} gives the same 409. Clicking 'Race friends' on the Paper #3 card went to /compete/?create=%7B%22paper%22%3A3... and showed the plain Compete page with no create sheet. grep finds no UI.createContest and no from_session or paper in server/api_compete.py. The share sheet's 'Create the race' hits the same 409 and falls back to that URL.
gaps.build: In POST /api/contests, accept from_session (a finished sitting the owner has) or paper (n). Build module 1's slots as twins, count 22, 35 minutes, open_for hours, and return {code, url}. Have /compete/ open its Create a private contest sheet preset from ?create= (or expose UI.createContest) so Race friends on paper and section cards opens it.

gaps.item: Time ran out while away, then Continue hangs forever at 'Time’s up. Handing in… 1 answer still saving…'
gaps.source: rebuild-v2.md §4.2 'Expired while away', §4.7 Time's up, §4.9 saving
gaps.evidence: Custom test (minutes 6): began it, reloaded, moved module_started back past the end, reopened. The lobby said 'Time ran out while you were away… Continue'. After Continue the view stayed at 'Time’s up. Handing in… 1 answer still saving…' for 20 s. localStorage held satf.pendstate.{sid} = [{qid:'c01', body:{ms:13439}}] and the sitting stayed finished=NULL. In test.js the queue's send awaits liveGate, which only start() opens. The expired path (begin → timeUp → handIn → flushOrWait → queue.wait()) never opens it. The line also counts state items as answers.
gaps.build: In test.js, open the queue gate (openGate()) before timeUp()/handIn on the expired path, and on any path that flushes without start(). Or skip queued state items older than the expiry. Count only kind 'answer' in the 'N answers still saving' line.

gaps.item: The runner's Ranked chip ignores the sitting's real rank: unrankable sittings show 'Ranked' and a paused sitting never shows 'Unranked · paused once'
gaps.source: tests.md X1 (Runner header), §3.1 item 6
gaps.evidence: runner.js:1327 sets text: training ? 'Training' : 'Ranked' and never reads S.ranked or S.why. The screenshot of a custom test (the lobby said 'won’t rank (custom test)') shows 'RANKED' in the header. The paused seeded Module 1 (server unranked_why 'paused once') opened at #review with chip 'Ranked'. {kind:'module', module:'m2u'} returns ranked:false, why 'single module 2', and would still show Ranked.
gaps.build: Pass S.ranked and S.why from test.js into UI.runner (for example o.rank {ranked, why}). Render 'Ranked' only when ranked. Otherwise render 'Unranked · <why>', with an aria-label that states the rule. Update the chip when a pause or the away limit drops the rank mid-module.

gaps.item: Hash routing: no #q7 or #review, so the browser's Back from Check your work leaves the test window

gaps.evidence: The hash stayed '' on Q2, on Shift+R to Check your work, and after clicking cell 5. page.go_back() from review left /test/ entirely. The runner only calls history.pushState in the report review player (runner.js:3212). test.js start() clears the hash.
gaps.build: In UI.runner exam mode, replaceState('#q{n}') on each question change and pushState('#review') when Check your work opens. On popstate back to a #q hash, close review and show that question. Leave #lobby, #between, #timeup and #done as test.js sets them.

gaps.item: How you take tests: the Last 5/10/All and Sections/All timed filters do nothing, and rows have no trend or 'Which sittings?'
gaps.source: tests.md X17 (Filters, Rows, Data)
gaps.evidence: tests.js calls /api/tests?habits_last=…&habits_scope=…, but tests_overview(x_learner) takes no query params and always calls habits(learner) with no last or scope. The habits rows payload (for example {'id':'blanks',...,'series':[5,5,1],'action':null,'why':...}) has no 'trend' and no 'sittings', so the page never shows the trend line or 'Which sittings?' (seen on the seeded page: 12 rows, none with either).

gaps.item: Shell Up next says a paused test's clock is still running (urgent) instead of 'Paused · … · mm:ss left'

gaps.item: /api/today returns 400 for every a: learner, so S5's server checks (test_flow) crash before shares, security and X23
gaps.source: rebuild-v2.md §3.4.8 acceptance 19 and 40; §3.4.5 'Today and latest_score'
gaps.evidence: GET /api/today with X-Learner a:auditseed01 (with or without X-Tz) returns 400 'send your learner token in the X-Learner header'. Traced: today_payload → review_counts → _call('api_review','counts', learner, tz) calls the route function counts(x_learner=…), which re-runs learner_of on the wrong argument. `PYTHONPATH=. python3 server/checks/s5.py` fails in rows_and_discard at c.get('/api/today'). gaps.build: In api_today.review_counts, call the review module's function (review.counts(learner, tz, subject)), not the route handler. Then check /api/today tested ignores discarded, custom and variant sittings, and rerun server/checks/s5.py to green.
